sourceReview.decision: All five dynamic routines assemble SELECT statements only and have no write target, but raw parameter concatenation is unsafe and must not be copied into the modern runtime.

sharedModernReplacementRequirements.requirement: Every modern query binds tenant and park before applying any legacy filter.
Park, managed-team, and self scope comes from server-side permissions and employee relationships; source rightscope is never authorization.
All scalar filters use bound parameters; no source SQL text, identifier, predicate, or quoted value is accepted from a client.
Legacy gradelist text becomes a validated array of grade codes and a bound membership predicate.
The response is withheld when required sensitive-read audit persistence fails.
Only explicit historical result fields are projected; internal hashes, migration control IDs, and unrestricted entities are excluded.
This seven-routine family never returns assessmentmaster.pay and must not gain payroll-field visibility implicitly.
